propositions: Multiple entry points (CLI, library, MCP, direct reconciler) must compose a single authoritative immutable OperationSnapshot containing validated non-secret effective config values with explicit provenance source kinds and repository root selection

Composition precedence is explicit operation input > environment > project config > user config > schema default, with repository root independently selected from explicit repo_root > REBAR_ROOT > Git top-level/current directory

Shadow mode is disabled by default via REBAR_OPERATION_SNAPSHOT_SHADOW environment variable; non-config snapshot assembly failures must not alter authoritative operation output or expose secrets/paths

Snapshot must be immutable, serializable, and exclude live auth objects, secret wrappers, provider clients, source-file paths, and subprocess environments from fields, fingerprinting, and all diagnostic/schema boundaries
Environment/file/cwd mutations after snapshot capture must not affect the captured snapshot; subsequent operations must observe new values
Malformed selected operation config must raise typed config error before lock, subprocess, network, or store effects occur
